intro: Maximise your space with Caliber 203. Its slim yet sturdy design blends storage and comfort, creating an organised workstation that helps you work, create, and focus with ease—no extra space needed.

features.title: Long-lasting surface you can trust
features.text: Built for real life—whether you’re working, relaxing, or entertaining, this sturdy top withstands daily use, offering long-lasting beauty and peace of mind.

features.title: Keyboard tray that makes typing comfortable
features.text: Typing made easy! This slide-out tray keeps your keyboard within reach while maintaining a clean, organised workspace.

features.title: Keep things tidy with dedicated spaces
features.text: No more desk chaos! A dedicated space neatly houses your CPU, printer, and books, keeping everything within reach.

features.title: Steel frame for strength and stability
features.text: Our rust-resistant frame ensures your furniture stays strong and stylish, resisting corrosion so it stands the test of time—even in changing seasons.

features.title: Space-saving design for tighter spaces
features.text: Tailored to fit snugly into smaller spaces, our versatile table offers essential functionality while keeping your home feeling open, airy, and inviting.

name: Caliber 203 Engineered Wood Computer Table
